_readme: Export to Revit (Shanku's DXF → 3D pipeline): which families and types Revit uses. Every key is optional; delete one to use its default.
Type names are patterns in whole millimetres: {W} width (short side), {L} length (long side), {H} depth, {T} thickness, {D} diameter.
A type with the resulting name is reused when the family has it; otherwise the family's first type is duplicated under that name and resized.

Sizing parameters (…Param) are the family's type parameters that set the size; the R25 template's families use W/L (columns), W/H (beams), Width/Length/Foundation Thickness (footings), W (round columns).
Slabs and walls are system families: the type is found by name, or the closest type is duplicated and its structural layer set to the thickness.
IdParam, MarkParam and LevelParam are shared parameters written on every element (leave one empty to skip it). IdParam lets a second export skip what Revit already has.
LevelMatchMm: a Revit level within this elevation of a drawing level is reused. CheckToleranceMm: placements further off than this are corrected or reported.
